closed_exit: The inactive exit. Will reactivate if you write the password while standing on it.
random_door: A door that opens randomly. The 'c' shows which set the door belongs to. The 'n' is the number of the door in the set.
teleporter: A time rift that teleports Archimede back in time. Going through it multiple times is enough to make it disappear.
riddle: A strange toast who wants you to solve their riddle.
broken_door: A damaged door. Might open if you try to break it enough times.

walk: Makes Archimede walk one step into the chosen direction.
open_door: Makes Archimede open the door in the chosen direction.
fortune: Asks the fortune teller which door will open in a set of random doors. The answer is the number of the door.
break_door: Makes Archimede try to break a damaged door in the chosen direction. The result is the success or failure.
get_riddle: Gets the riddle the toast wants you to solve in the chosen direction.
solve_riddle: Gives your solution to the toast in the chosen direction.
